name: Four Seasons Hotel Tianjin
positioning: Urban Four Seasons hotel in Tianjin's central business district, in the Heping District, steps from shopping and historic neighbourhoods.
best_for: Travelers who want a central Tianjin base near Binjiang Avenue shopping
Families who want a themed family room and a kids program
Visitors combining Tianjin with a 30-minute high-speed train ride from Beijing

facts.text: Four Seasons Hotel Tianjin opened in January 2017.
The hotel is at 138 Chifeng Road, Heping District, Tianjin.
The hotel has 259 accommodations in total.
Of the 259 accommodations, 215 are guest rooms.
The hotel's interior designer is Pierre-Yves Rochon.
The hotel is in the Central Business District, steps from historic neighbourhoods that date back to the 1800s.
The high-speed train reaches Tianjin from Beijing in 30 minutes.
Tianjin Binhai International Airport is 45 minutes by car from the hotel.
The hotel's fitness centre is open 24 hours a day.

highlights.text: The hotel has a 25-metre skylit swimming pool.
Jin House is an award-winning Cantonese restaurant.
Cielo serves a buffet of grilled meats, fresh seafood and handmade sweets.
Gusto Bar has floor-to-ceiling windows showing Tianjin's lights.
The hotel's Family Themed Room has one king bed and one bunk bed with a slide.
The hotel has a Kids For All Seasons in-house kids program.
The hotel has an Executive Club Lounge on the sixth floor.

considerations.text: L'Océan Spa is open daily from 10:00 am to 10:00 pm.
The beautifully preserved European buildings of Wu Da Dao are a 10-minute drive from the hotel.
Binjiang Avenue's shopping is steps from the hotel, in the Central Business District.
WhataHotel notes the hotel is in a business-focused location that may feel formal for leisure travelers.

perks.text: With the WhataHotel Preferred Rate, breakfast for two is free daily.
With the WhataHotel Preferred Rate, guests get a priority upgrade if available at check-in.
With the WhataHotel Preferred Rate, guests get a $100 hotel credit.
WhataHotel special offers can be combined with the exclusive perks.
With the WhataHotel Preferred Rate, guests get free Wi-Fi access.
